title: ziziphora clinopodioides subsp. pseudodasyantha
intro: Ziziphora clinopodioides subsp. pseudodasyantha, commonly known as Mountain Mint, is a plant species belonging to the Lamiaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing various health benefits such as relieving digestive issues and reducing inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Mountain Mint include its analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and carminative properties, making it a potential remedy for digestive and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Mountain Mint include essential oils like menthone and menthol, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
